name: Adventurers Camp
operator_name: Town of Greenwich Parks and Recreation
street_address: Bendheim Western Greenwich Civic Center, 449 Pemberwick Road
description_short: A town run day camp for ages 8 to 15, 9 am to 4 pm, based at the Bendheim Western Greenwich Civic Center. Campers are grouped by age, have theme weeks at the center, take one field trip a week and spend days at Byram Shore, Greenwich Point and Island Beach, with transport to trips and beaches included.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds and no prorating. Requests for full credit are considered before June 1, half credit on or after June 1, and credit is prorated once camp begins. Credits carry a $20 administrative fee.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Adventurers Camp registration form. Prices are the non-resident rates (Session I $670, Session II $565); residents pay $560 and $475 early bird, $615 and $520 from June 1. Grades are the grade entering in fall 2026. No camp July 3.
